messages.subject: symbolic diff paper
parts:
An Adobe colleague pointed me to this paper on symbolic
differentiation that might be relevant to Stan (someday when the to-do
list is a little shorter):

http://research.microsoft.com/en-us/um/people/bguenter/docs/symbolicDifferentiation.pdf

Seems sort of interesting, although I think it's geared more towards
differentiating vector-valued rather than scalar-valued functions.
Still, might be useful for computing derivatives of vector-valued
functions (e.g., eigenvectors) within Stan's reverse-mode autodiff.

Matt
